changelog: FIX (Fire Stick OOM at cold launch — surgical): Disabled two AndroidX auto-init ContentProviders that run BEFORE our Application.onCreate and consume memory we couldn't previously control. (a) EmojiCompatInitializer loaded the emoji compat font from disk (~5-10 MB peak) — we don't use emoji compat anywhere. (b) ProfileInstallerInitializer did synchronous disk I/O for AOT compile profiles on first launch — exactly the kind of blocking I/O that contributes to OOM kills on slow Fire Stick eMMC. Both are now removed via manifest tools:node='remove'. ProcessLifecycleInitializer is KEPT — we depend on it for the trial countdown + license logic. Net effect: less peak memory + less disk I/O during the most fragile moment of app launch.
